definitions: A process by which an animal or insect changes completely from an immature form to an adult form in two or more distinct stages.
A profound change in form from one stage to the next in the life history of an organism, as from the caterpillar to the pupa and from the pupa to the adult butterfly.
A change of the form or nature of a thing or person into a completely different one.
examples: The metamorphosis of a caterpillar into a butterfly.
The company has undergone a metamorphosis from a manufacturing company to a service provider.
His metamorphosis from a shy boy to a confident leader was remarkable.
